Maya P: Quick UX check — session timeout modal copy + keyboard focus order. Screenshot attached: https://redwood-internal.mock/snap/session-timeout.png Current copy: primary=\"Keep working\" secondary=\"Sign out now\". Also noticed DOM has secondary button before primary, so tab stops go Sign out -> Keep working. Is that ok? Jordan (ENG): I don't love \"Keep working\" — vague for screen reader users. Prefer the explicit verb \"Extend session\". Also agree on fixing DOM order so primary comes first. Right now frontend renders actions array in source order; I'll flip it in the component. Samira (A11y): Strong +1 for explicit verbs. For the modal itself: role=\"dialog\", aria-modal=\"true\", and set focus to the first focusable (the primary). Add aria-live=\"polite\" for the timeout copy: \"Your session will expire in 2 minutes. Choose to extend or sign out.\" Also: do NOT bind Escape to sign out — Escape should close the modal and restore focus to the triggering control. Liam (PM): Product/metrics want users to clearly understand action. Would prefer \"Sign out\" (no \"now\") for the secondary — less alarmist. If we can A/B test \"Extend session\" vs \"Stay signed in\" downstream, fine. Maya P: Updated copy proposals: option A = primary \"Extend session\" / secondary \"Sign out\"; option B = primary \"Stay signed in\" / secondary \"Sign out\". I'll change visual to show primary on left (in toolbar) but DOM will be primary-first for accessibility. Thoughts? Jordan (ENG): Option A is clearer for intent. Also note a bug I saw: pressing Escape currently triggers the secondary click handler (weird). I'll investigate — likely event propagation on keydown. Should be fixed before shipping. Samira (A11y): If preserving native expectations: primary should be focused on open, enter/space triggers primary, Escape closes (like Cancel). Screen reader announcement example:
Your session will expire in 2 minutes. Choose \u2014 Extend session or Sign out.
Link the dialog description with aria-describedby to that element. Maya P: Good points. I'll update the prototype and add copy variants into the design file. Plan: implement copy A, change DOM order, add aria-live and role changes, and ensure Escape closes (not signs out).@Jordan please don't wire Escape -> sign out. Jordan (ENG): Got it. I'll change the component: move primary button before secondary in DOM, set initial focus to primary via ref, stop Escape from triggering sign out. Will open a small PR and tag you. Liam (PM): Sounds good. Can we also add a tiny hint for keyboard users: \"Press Esc to dismiss\"? Might help discoverability. Samira (A11y): If you add that hint, hide it visually but keep it accessible (sr-only). Keep messaging short. Maya P: Will do. I'll push updated mock and include the SR copy snippet and aria attributes in the PR description. aria-bot: preview build deployed: https://preview.redwood-internal/mock/session-timeout/v2 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Jordan (ENG): PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/4521 — includes DOM reorder, aria-live text, Escape key fix. Requesting review from @Samira and @Maya. Samira (A11y): Reviewing now, quick glance looks good. Will leave a couple of nit comments about focus styles. Maya P: Thanks all — merging after nits addressed. I'll schedule a quick usability pass after deploy. :thumbsup:
